# Dependency upgrade

Upgrade a third-party dependency to a new major version. Read its changelog, fix the breaking changes and run the tests.

## Steps

1. Read the request and confirm the scope.
2. Follow the checklist for this kind of work.
3. Report what changed and how it was verified.
